## Conventional Commit

<!--
Your PR title must follow Conventional Commits format. Accepted types:

  feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, revert

For breaking changes, add ! after the type: feat!: breaking change

The title becomes the commit message on main, because pull requests are
squash-merged. CI rejects a title that does not match.
-->
